_readme: S505 SkyBoysenberry, 2026-10-28. Second Glendale read. Its program pages print subjects and codes the state's file keeps under another prefix or a new number: PSYCH for PSYC (11 records), TART for THTR (9), ART for ARTH (5), and ENGL 101, ENGL 104 and POL S 101 where the file lists ENGL C1000, ENGL C1001 and POL S C1000. The first read (glendale_program_totals, run 40690480267) printed ENGL C1000's description with '(Previously ENGL 101)'. A prefix alias and a renumber need the title on both sides, so this read prints the course-description pages that name Sports Psychology, Introduction to Theatre, Art History and Critical Thinking and Writing, and the 'Previously' lines for ENGL 104 and POL S 101. One load of the 2025-2026 PDF, no model call.

questions.prefix_titles: The code and title each description prints for the four subjects, and the 'Previously' line of each renumbered course.
